XYZ is a 3-digit number such that it is the square of a multiple of 5. What will be the HIGHEST possible remainder of (XYZ)/100?
a) 10
b) 15
c) 20
d) 25
My answer
Dyna Thinking Coach
Starter
decide how to begin
Begin with the list: which multiples of 5 have a 3-digit square?
Roots
ask why it works
Ask why the last two digits repeat: what do squares of numbers ending in 0 end with? And ending in 5?
YOUR TURN
The remainder is the last two digits. Pick the highest.
